integrity: The infinite statements are proved structurally; finite exhaustive computations are used only as checks of the combinatorial mechanisms.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to equal-block homogeneous cluster graphs and their complements.
Only endomorphism image-cardinality spectra are classified, not the full endomorphism monoids.
An uncatalogued-folklore risk remains because the structural proof is short.
title: Complement swaps the core parameter in homogeneous cluster graphs
